title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. I have a Mango plantation 40 km from my place, I am working in a company and my father states with me and is too old to look after the plantation. This being the case is it permissible for me to give it on lease for 3-5years? 1829 views Q. Teaching finance education to students 7994 views Q. Can you plz let me know that is it jayaz ( allowed /reasonable) in islam make the LIC policy or any other policy in which a policy provider says that you submit this much amount of installment and in case of your sudden demise , the nominee will get a very much hafty amout like of 15 laks or 25 lakhs ,Or your money will be doubled. 2089 views Q. Is it permissible to take an IT contract job through an intermediary broker for designing/improving computer systems for an insurance company? 2058 views Q. After selling my elder brother asked for hand loan & I gave hand loan (kharzi hasana) to him Rs.270000/- for 3 month commitment only. Till today I did not get back the money. Even I used hard words after the maturity. He has the money but he is not giving, investing in real estate and earning money with my money. & I am waiting when he will return back my money I will by the plot. Now the land prices are so high & increased 13 to 15 times more in this 6 years timne. Even which I sold the above plot price 15 times increased. Due to block this hand loan money I did not invest the amount in plot. If I invested above sold plot amount in another plot present value will be around Rs.75 to 80 lakhs will get. For this I have lost lakhs of rupees. So requesting to provide me a fatwa above my lakhs of rupees loses. Now how much I have to collect with him? Actual amount or actual amount plus loses. 1769 views Q. Also in that resort some guests come and drink alcohol etc. though my brother does not supply.But they get it along with them. Is this permissible? Is running of resorts allowed in Islam? 1800 views Q. I am presently living in Oman. In this country unlike in Sri Lanka or India it is difficult to find public transportation. Almost everyone has his or her car for transportation. So it has become a must having a car for one's transport. I find its difficult to get a car paying a lump sum. I decided to approach a bank for vehicle loan. I am aware that riba is prohibited. But in this particular bank the loan amount and the interest portion everything is pre-determined. It will not fluctuate. This results a fixed monthly installment to be paid and there would not be a change in the installment, period of settlement, additional amount I am supposed to pay the bank. So my question is Can I relate this to the Islamic system since everything is pre-determined and my monthly installment is also fixed. please reply me. I need to take the decision with in the next coupkle of days. 1662 views Q. My house given for rent, when I increase the security money and decrease the rent of the house, is it halal or harm . 2My house give for using another person, only bring security,what is the rulling. 2441 views Q. We have own house. 3rd floor of the house is not build yet. Our neighbor offered us to construct the 3rd floor, He give total cost as a condition that he stay one apartment as rent free for next three years. This floor will became 4 apartment. Another 3 apartment we give rent others tenant. After 3 years we paid her full money which he give for build house and he leave home. My question, is it permissible in islam? Mention that: 1. He get back her full money after 3 years which he give for constructing house as he benefited he will stay rent free. 2. We collect her money from rent price of the rest 3 apartment. 3. If we deny he may keep money in bank and get interest and the interest become close to rent price per month. Please answer as soon as possible. 1578 views Q. Will the amount be considered as interest amount ? 2) the investment done in the above scheme is non-refundable, the money will not refunded after 30 years, the benefit is the only thing which you get every month rs 6600/-. 1451 views
answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Other Transactions Question ID: 1501 Country: India Title: Please tell me whether I can borrow a heavy amount on interest from the Bank to develop my parental house which is in afflicted condition and wherein my poor brother is living, whereas my wife is sole owner of some cash and a valueable plot which was received from her father. And She will never agree to develop my parental house at her own cost. Can I borrow loan on interest from Bank for the same? Question: Assalamu - Alaikum, Please tell me whether I can borrow a heavy amount on interest from the Bank to develop my parental house which is in afflicted condition and wherein my poor brother is living, whereas my wife is sole owner of some cash and a valueable plot which was received from her father. And She will never agree to develop my parental house at her own cost. Can I borrow loan on interest from Bank for the same? Answer ID: 1501 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 924/863=B) If you do not have money, you are poor and no one is ready to give you debt and it is necessary to build house then you can take loan from bank under this exigent condition as per the need of the construction: ویجوز للمحتاج الاستقراض بالربح (الاشباہ) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
